definitions.gloss: private ownership; belonging to a private individual
definitions.explanation: Ownership by a private person or entity, as opposed to public or government ownership. Used in legal, economic, and property contexts.

examples.japanese: {私有|しゆう}{地|ち}に{立|た}ち{入|い}り{禁止|きんし}。
この{森|もり}は{私有|しゆう}{林|りん}です。
{私有|しゆう}{財産|ざいさん}の{権利|けんり}は{憲法|けんぽう}で{保障|ほしょう}されている。
examples.english: The right to private property is guaranteed by the constitution.

notes: Composed of {私|し} (private, personal) + {有|ゆう} (possess, own). The opposite is {公有|こうゆう} (public ownership) or {国有|こくゆう} (state ownership). Common collocations: {私有|しゆう}{地|ち} (private land), {私有|しゆう}{財産|ざいさん} (private property), {私有|しゆう}{林|りん} (private forest), {私有|しゆう}{物|ぶつ} (private belongings), {私有|しゆう}{化|か} (privatization). Part of the {〜有|ゆう} ownership family: {所有|しょゆう} (ownership), {共有|きょうゆう} (shared ownership), {国有|こくゆう} (state-owned).
